# Architecture overview

**What it is.** A static site generated by Astro 7 at build time (`astro.config.mjs` keeps the HTML-aware
whitespace compression, `compressHTML: true`, instead of Astro 7's JSX rules, which can drop the space between
inline elements written on separate lines). Routes: the home page `/` (hero, the hub of
five cells) and one page per topic: `/services/` (also the delivered work),
`/how-we-work/`, `/about/` with the founder, `/contact/`. There is
no server code, no database, no form backend and no client framework. Four small scripts run in the browser: the
phone menu toggle in `Header.astro`, Scout, the question bot, in `ScoutChat.astro`, the honeycomb interaction in
`CombVisual.astro`, and the hub's count-up in `hive/HiveDashboard.astro`, whose cells are plain links. The hub's
numbers and the Services page's fields and results are reduced at build time from the data
and the collection by `src/lib/dashboard.ts` (ADR 0005).

**How the pages are put together.** Each page in `src/pages/` composes its sections in order inside
`src/layouts/Base.astro`, which holds the `<head>` (meta, canonical, share tags, fonts, structured data) and the
page backdrop. Each section is one component in `src/components/` with its own scoped styles; shared primitives
(wrap, eyebrow, chips, buttons, cards) and the tokens are in `src/styles/global.css`. Content comes from typed
modules in `src/data/`, so a missing field fails `npm run check` instead of rendering empty. Header links,
the hub, the phone bar and Scout point at pages by path (`<base>/services/`, `<base>/contact/`), so they work from
every page. `Process.astro` takes a `page` prop that renders it as the main content of
its own page (h1, page spacing); `Services.astro` is the Services page itself, built from the projects.

**Projects.** The content collection `projects` (`src/content.config.ts`, a Zod schema; files in
`src/content/projects/`, frontmatter only) holds the delivered projects. `src/lib/projects.ts` sorts them, picks
the projects Scout names as examples from `featuredProjects` (`src/data/work.ts`; an unknown id throws, so the build
fails) and builds the link to a project's box (`/services/#<id>`). `Services.astro` renders them all on one
page as a honeycomb with popups copied from the portfolio (`hive/ProjectHive.astro`, `hive/ProjectDetails.astro`,
`lib/honeycomb.ts`; ADR 0007), the descriptions word for word, the dashed 404 cell last. The files are not written here: they are a declared copy of the
portfolio's project frontmatter (the orgs listed in the setting `PROJECT_ORGS`), made by `scripts/sync-projects.mjs`
from a local clone of ManSe404/webpage at a git ref (default `origin/main`). The script records the source
commit in each file, copies no write-up and no company or client name, applies `scripts/project-edits.json`
(identifying fields replaced, the company voice) and reports an edit that no longer fits or a first-person line
left ([ADR 0008](../adr/0008-no-partner-or-client-names.md))
([ADR 0006](../adr/0006-one-services-page-short-project-form.md)). It runs by hand, never in CI.

**Scout.** `ScoutChat.astro` renders the launcher and the panel. At build time it calls `buildFaq`
(`src/data/faq.ts`) with the page paths and the project titles, fields and tools from the collection, and
writes the resulting list into the page as JSON; the browser script reads that JSON and matches with
`src/lib/faq.ts`. A question is split into word stems, each entry's keyword phrases score one point per
matching stem, and the best entry answers; a suggestion question asked verbatim always returns its own entry.
Answers are composed from the same data as the pages.
Messages are added with `textContent`, never as HTML. Nothing is sent over the network or stored. Any element
with `data-scout-open` opens the panel: the floating launcher on desktop, the bee in the sticky bar on a phone,
where the panel is a bottom sheet. Why a fixed list and no model: [ADR 0003](../adr/0003-scout-answers-from-a-fixed-list.md).

**One page, two layouts.** Desktop and phone get the same HTML. Components switch layout with media queries at
860 px (header, hero) and 640 px (lists, timeline, two hub cells per row, sticky bar, Scout's bottom sheet), following the
artboards of the design ([design/README.md](../design/README.md)). The page never sets `overflow-x: hidden` on
`body`; the decorative backdrop clips itself.

**What it depends on outside itself.**

| Outside system | Used for | If it is down |
|---|---|---|
| GitHub Pages | Hosting at the project URL `https://manse404.github.io/404solutions-site/` (`site` and `base` in `astro.config.mjs`), once published (roadmap 1) | The site is unreachable |
| Google Fonts | Space Grotesk and DM Mono | The page falls back to system fonts |
| Portfolio repository (ManSe404/webpage) | Source of the project copy, read from a local clone by `scripts/sync-projects.mjs` when someone runs it; the site does not link to it | Nothing at run time; the next sync waits |
| Gmail and LinkedIn | The contact routes, by `mailto:` and link; LinkedIn is the only personal profile linked | Contact goes through the other one |

**Checks and deploy.** `.github/workflows/site.yml` runs `npm ci`, `npm run check`, `npm test`, `npm run build`
and `npm run check:links` (`scripts/check-links.mjs`: every internal link and anchor in `dist/` resolves) on
every pull request and on `main`. On `main` it then uploads `dist/` and deploys it to GitHub Pages (source:
GitHub Actions). A ruleset on the default branch requires a pull request and the `build` check, and blocks
force pushes and deletion, so nothing is published unchecked. Dependabot (`.github/dependabot.yml`) opens
weekly grouped update PRs for npm and the Actions; it skips major bumps of TypeScript (`@astrojs/check` supports
5 and 6 only) and of `@types/node` (it follows the Node 24 the workflow runs).
`npm test` runs `node --test` over `tests/*.test.ts` with Node's built-in type stripping: no test framework,
no network.

**Decisions.** [ADR 0001](../adr/0001-own-repository-for-the-company-site.md) (own repository),
[ADR 0002](../adr/0002-hive-tokens-copied-from-the-portfolio.md) (copied tokens),
[ADR 0003](../adr/0003-scout-answers-from-a-fixed-list.md) (Scout without a model),
[ADR 0004](../adr/0004-case-studies-live-on-the-company-site.md) (the work copied here, no personal links),
[ADR 0005](../adr/0005-hive-dashboard-copied-from-the-portfolio.md) (the hub, copied from the portfolio's dashboard, own data layer),
[ADR 0006](../adr/0006-one-services-page-short-project-form.md) (one Services page, short project form),
[ADR 0007](../adr/0007-project-honeycomb-copied-from-the-portfolio.md) (the project honeycomb, copied from the portfolio),
[ADR 0008](../adr/0008-no-partner-or-client-names.md) (no partner or client names, no agency framing).
